quest.title: A Fontainian Message
quest.description: You meet two people where you first met Virgil, and they have the same goal. They seem... nice. It's time to get an explanation from Virgil.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Mora x15000, Hero's Wit x2

dialogues.speaker: Sonny
dialogues.text: Now, this is a most serendipitous meeting. Won't you agree, my dear Luca?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Sonny
dialogues.text: Apologies. Look at me, beginning a conversation without even introducing myself. I am Sonny, the one they sometimes call the "White Glove." My friend here is Luca the Fisherman. He's pretty famous in certain circles.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, hello! Paimon is...

dialogues.speaker: Sonny
dialogues.text: #It's most alright. I know that you are Paimon, and this {M#blond}{F#blonde} traveler is {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? You know us already?

dialogues.speaker: Sonny
dialogues.text: But of course! It's just that before today, my knowledge of you was much like my knowledge of the Chief Justice. In other words, I knew of you, but you did not know of me.

dialogues.speaker: Sonny
dialogues.text: With your fame and accomplishments, it is only natural that news of your arrival would reach us as soon as you stepped foot in Fontaine.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We're that famous?

dialogues.speaker: Sonny
dialogues.text: Ah, you're too humble. How should I put it? ...Hmm, to certain people, your arrival in Fontaine would be as if someone had just set off a bomb on the stage of Opera Epiclese.

dialogues.speaker: Sonny
dialogues.text: —Of course, I mean this in only the most positive way. Don't you agree, my dear Luca?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Er, but how can a bomb going off ever be a good thing...

dialogues.speaker: Sonny
dialogues.text: Hm... I'm not very good with words. How would you put it, my dear Luca?

dialogues.speaker: Luca
dialogues.text: Lyney and Lynette's magic show. Blasting everything wide open to accomplish the impossible. Spine-tingling experience.

dialogues.speaker: Sonny
dialogues.text: Precisely! See, I would have never thought to put it like that.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: I—If you say so...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why are you called the "White Glove," though? Paimon doesn't see a glove at all...

dialogues.speaker: Sonny
dialogues.text: Ooh, now that's a hard question. How should I explain?

dialogues.speaker: Sonny
dialogues.text: Imagine, if you will, that you're wearing a white glove. If something dirty were to get on your hand, then a dark mark would be left on the glove. My duty... would be to find that dark mark and remove it from view.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh... So you're something like a cleaner?

dialogues.speaker: Sonny
dialogues.text: Exactly, my dear Paimon! See, I was never able to so succinctly summarize the nature of my work.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ahh, so people like you are the reason why the streets of the Court of Fontaine are always so well-kept and tidy!

dialogues.speaker: Sonny
dialogues.text: Hahaha, that's what I like to hear! Yes, you may understand it like that.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, that makes sense to Paimon... But why would a cleaner need a knife?

dialogues.speaker: Sonny
dialogues.text: You may think of it as a small tool of the trade that we bring out when there are marks that are particularly hard to remove.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Got it, thanks! So... is your friend Luca here "Luca the Fisherman" because he's really good at fishing?

dialogues.speaker: Sonny
dialogues.text: Hmm — that's only a part of the story, I am afraid. See, there are many kinds of fish in Fontaine as well.

dialogues.speaker: Sonny
dialogues.text: And Luca here is really experienced at teaching people to spend some quality time with all the different kinds of fish. Am I right, my dear Luca?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Paimon doesn't get it... If that's the case, then—

dialogues.speaker: Sonny
dialogues.text: I must say, dear Paimon, that you've really got a knack for asking the most difficult and fascinating questions. It would be most wonderful if we could have a longer conversation, where I would be able to answer everything to your full satisfaction.

choices.text: Paimon, it's okay to stop asking.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? Alright then... Sonny and Luca, is there something you'd like to ask us?

response.speaker: Sonny
response.text: You see, we're extremely intrigued by the practice of diving. Fontaine's waters are full of priceless treasures, left by nature and our ancestors alike.

response.speaker: Sonny
response.text: We heard that you had made a good friend recently, and even went for a dive with him. Your powers were such that you didn't even need to use any diving equipment, isn't that right, my dear Luca?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You want to ask about Virgil.

response.speaker: Sonny
response.text: Yes. We want to ask about Virgil.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Virgil... That liar and traitor! Ahh, just remembering him makes Paimon mad!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You recount your experiences with Virgil to Sonny the White Glove and Luca the Fisherman.

response.speaker: Sonny
response.text: ...I see, I see. Thank you for telling us all of this.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're welcome! Hmph, Paimon hasn't forgotten a single thing about that guy.

response.speaker: Sonny
response.text: We are, of course, exceedingly grateful that you were willing to share the whole story with us. However, from my own perspective, I am even more relieved that you do not consider Virgil to be a friend. If that hadn't been the case...

response.speaker: Sonny
response.text: Hmm, maybe I can put it like this: had you seen him as a friend, things would have become quite awkward for both of us. Isn't that right, my dear Luca?

response.speaker: Luca
response.text: It could make things difficult.

response.speaker: Sonny
response.text: I agree, I agree. Thank you so much.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What are you talking about...?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: They are Virgil's enemies.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ahh!

response.speaker: Sonny
response.text: #Your words wound me, {M#my dear sir}{F#my lovely lady}. I have many friends and not a single enemy. Virgil is just one of my many friends — and ah, speaking of dear Virgil...

response.speaker: Sonny
response.text: #I think it's about time that we have a serious "talk" with him. Surely you understand what I mean, dear {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Sonny
response.text: Of course, this is also so that we can get back at him for what he's done to you. It's the least we can do for our honored guests, don't you think?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Er, Paimon is lost...

choices.text: He's the White Glove. That's all you have to know.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ermm... Okay...

response.speaker: Sonny
response.text: We've already found the stronghold of Virgil and the rest of his friends. Why don't we meet up there?

choices.text: Why do we also need to go...

response.speaker: Sonny
response.text: #My {M#good sir}{F#lovely lady}! With how much Virgil has wronged you, we cannot possibly have... our conversation with him without informing you of our plans beforehand.

response.speaker: Sonny
response.text: See, Luca agrees as well.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmph! Paimon wants to talk to Virgil too! He has to make a formal apology to us!

response.speaker: Sonny
response.text: Hahaha, you are too kind. Then let's meet up at our destination.

choices.text: It's okay to not understand everything, Paimon...

response.speaker: Sonny
response.text: #Life can often become extremely boring when you understand everything in this world, isn't that right, my {M#good sir}{F#lovely lady}?

dialogues.speaker: Virgil
dialogues.text: Please let me explain... This is all a misunderstanding...

dialogues.speaker: Virgil
dialogues.text: Mr. Sonny... You see, we only got into this business because we heard there was Mora to be made, and since the higher-ups didn't agree, we figured... We figured we could just earn the money first, and then turn all of the profits over, yeah, that's exactly it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, he's totally ignoring Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Virgil
dialogues.text: I have no complaints against the organization, none at all... Oh right, I was also tricked by these crooks! That's the only reason at all why I did something so foolish...

dialogues.speaker: Sonny
dialogues.text: #Impressive, very impressive. {NICKNAME}, you are every inch as strong as the stories have made you out to be. Don't you agree, my dear Luca?

dialogues.speaker: Luca
dialogues.text: Super strong. Incredibly formidable.

dialogues.speaker: Virgil
dialogues.text: Please, if you still remember anything about the time we spent together... Mr. Sonny... Mr. Luca...

dialogues.speaker: Virgil
dialogues.text: Argh! Please, please no...

dialogues.speaker: Sonny
dialogues.text: Luca, our guests are still here. Let's not do anything discourteous that might bring down their mood.

dialogues.speaker: Luca
dialogues.text: Understood.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph! See the errors of your ways now, Virgil?

dialogues.speaker: Virgil
dialogues.text: Ahh, it was my fault, it was all my fault... Please, have mercy...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, at least you've admitted that you have done something wrong. Now make sure you won't do it again!

dialogues.speaker: Sonny
dialogues.text: #My dear Virgil would never do something like that again. Paimon, {NICKNAME}, I can promise you that on the honor of Sonny the White Glove, as well as that of my father and son.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Mhm! Thank you so much, Sonny and Luca. It seems that there are more good than bad people in Fontaine, after all!

response.speaker: Sonny
response.text: #Farewell, dear Paimon, and my {M#good sir}{F#lovely lady}. I hope there'll come a day when we'll be able to work together again.

response.speaker: Virgil
response.text: Eeek...

choices.text: What are you going to do now?

response.speaker: Sonny
response.text: #Life can often become extremely boring when you understand everything in this world, isn't that right, my {M#good sir}{F#lovely lady}?

response.speaker: Sonny
response.text: And if you must know, we will have... a long and very serious chat with him. We will not take any more of your time, however.

dialogues.speaker: Sonny
dialogues.text: #Dear Paimon, and my {M#good sir}{F#lovely lady}.

dialogues.speaker: Sonny
dialogues.text: This is the stronghold that Virgil has been using as of late.

dialogues.speaker: Sketchy-looking person
dialogues.text: I swear, why is Virgil still not back yet...

dialogues.speaker: Dangerous-looking person
dialogues.text: If he's just gonna keep us waiting, I might not be able to... hold myself back from this shipment of Sinthe...

dialogues.speaker: Untrustworthy-looking person
dialogues.text: Hey, cut it out! That shipment took us an arm and a leg to get. Virgil will have no mercy for you if you were to just take it without his permission.

dialogues.speaker: Sonny
dialogues.text: What a pity. It would seem that my dear friend Virgil hasn't returned to the stronghold yet. We can still have a chat with these guys, however.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Er, but it doesn't look like they're in the mood for a chat...

dialogues.speaker: Sonny
dialogues.text: Hm, but I think they may change their minds soon enough. What do you think, my dear Luca?

dialogues.speaker: Luca
dialogues.text: No problem.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! Are you sure that there'd be no problem? Paimon thinks they'll probably just try to beat you up!

dialogues.speaker: Sonny
dialogues.text: Oh no! You are too considerate, dear Paimon. Something like that would be most unfortunate indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Sonny
dialogues.text: ...For them, of course.

dialogues.speaker: Sonny
dialogues.text: Alright, my dear Virgil... You've really put us through a lot of trouble. Now then, what should we do with you?

dialogues.speaker: Virgil
dialogues.text: S—Sorry...

dialogues.speaker: Sonny
dialogues.text: This won't do, this won't do at all. You know full well that time flies, and it is now too late for you to turn back. Our organization has a justice code all on our own, and one of our most important rules is that there are some trades that you just never do.

dialogues.speaker: Virgil
dialogues.text: But... But Mr. Sonny, please just listen to me, the profit margin on this, it's just...

dialogues.speaker: Sonny
dialogues.text: Ah, not this again. Mora, Mora, Mora — is there anything you care about other than Mora? What about your pride as a citizen of Fontaine? What about your conscience as you watch our countrymen turn into husks of themselves from this drink?

dialogues.speaker: Luca
dialogues.text: Bah!

dialogues.speaker: Sonny
dialogues.text: Oho? How shocking, even Luca is showing intense emotion in response to your words. You see, my dear Virgil, you've truly accomplished the impossible.

dialogues.speaker: Virgil
dialogues.text: Mr. Sonny, I... Please believe me, i—it's all because of what those guys said, they lied to me, I—I would not have done anything if not for...

dialogues.speaker: Sonny
dialogues.text: Silence, you worthless dross!

dialogues.speaker: Virgil
dialogues.text: Argh!

dialogues.speaker: Sonny
dialogues.text: You're the exact kind of lowlife I've got no time for. Even now, you're still trying to lie to me? Huh? Are you beyond dumb, or do you think I'm dumb? Not so talkative now, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Sonny
dialogues.text: #You even tried to hurt {NICKNAME}. Did you have even the faintest inkling of who you were asked to deal with? To think that he could have trained someone as clueless as you... I've really got to have a good conversation with him...

dialogues.speaker: Sonny
dialogues.text: But that will not be something you'll need to worry about, my dear Virgil.
